card.name: Joining words after a described action
card.fires_on: Commas, linking words (to, as, so, and) and word endings that come right after a verb phrase describing an action and its object. A second action, purpose or alternative is expected next.

modes.label: Linking word after an action
modes.description: A comma or small word such as to, so, as or and follows an action phrase and leads into a purpose, a second step or an alternative.
modes.example: slow the water down<< so>> that it can soak into the ground,

modes.label: Ending of a treatment word
modes.description: The last piece of a procedure or drug word such as phlebotomy, emesis or metoclopramide, where "or" or a setting follows.
modes.example: or with phlebot<<omy>>, as clinically indicated

card.plain: It fires at the point in a sentence where one action has been named and a second action, reason or alternative is about to be added.
